routine.title: Community pool lap or open swim
routine.stage_fit_rationale: Teens benefit from independent, drop-in physical activity they can control the pace of; open swim lets them go solo or with friends without a rigid class structure, fitting their interest in swimming.

routine.title: Teen volunteer or maker program
routine.stage_fit_rationale: Self-directed maker/coding programs suit a teenager's need for autonomy and identity-building through skill-based projects, and it aligns with their coding interest.

parsed.rationale: A light two-item week spaced midweek, both optional and self-directed, respecting a teenager's need to own their schedule rather than have it packed by parents.
parsed.notes: Both candidates are placed since they fit well and align with stated interests; no items were left out. Days chosen (Tue/Thu) just give spacing—parent/teen should feel free to shift or skip either since these are framed as optional per teen stage norms.
